newsitem.title: MEXICO: TMM, APL to form joint shipping venture.
newsitem.headline: TMM, APL to form joint shipping venture.

text.p: Mexico's Transportacion Maritima Mexicana SA (TMM) and APL Ltd of the United States signed a preliminary agreement to form a joint venture for container shipping between Mexico and Asia, the companies said on Tuesday.
"Both companies agreed that the accord would allow them to improve efficiency in their line service and offer better service to their clients," the companies said in a statement.
TMM spokesman Fernando Ruiz told Reuters the companies were still in negotiations and had not yet decided on the size of their investments in the new venture.
TMM will hold 57.5 percent of the company, while APL will have the remaining 42.5 percent, the statement said.
A final agreement will require approval of the Mexican government and each company's board of directors.

"The joint company will provide transport operations and other services for the two companies, while TMM and APL will maintain its own existing sales, marketing and client services," the companies said.
